svg.title: Core entity-relationship diagram
svg.desc: Core ERD showing seven domain tables, their fields and eight core foreign keys. Child-to-parent FK arrows carry parent/child multiplicities; composite score and attendance keys enforce matching sections. Creator attribution is detailed in Figure 3.
svg.text: Physical keys and ownership for shared course rules and private academic records.

g.text: One score and one attendance row per enrollment/component pair.
Arrow: child foreign key -> parent key. End labels: parent : child count.
RESTRICT protects referenced records; all other core FKs use CASCADE.
Nullable creator_id and shared-history attribution appear in Figure 3.

svg.text: PK = primary key; FK = foreign key; ? = nullable | Application additionally enforces consent and ownership
